objective: Test whether a deployable label-free retrieval rule can select an external online state that improves native scene boundary detection over the row-correct state.
claim_boundary: This post-validation TRAIN-derived development study can nominate a state-retrieval method for fresh replication. It cannot change the accepted validation decoder or create a new untouched native benchmark claim.

data_scope.state_bank_role: external state exemplars only; never target evaluation rows
data_scope.partition_rule: holdout iff unsigned integer from first eight hex characters of target row SHA-256 modulo five equals zero; otherwise fit

label_free_features.text_scope: user message content only; system instruction and assistant gold excluded
label_free_features.token_count: frozen base-model tokenizer over the write prompt
label_free_features.character_vectorizer: TF-IDF of character n-grams with n in {2,3,4}, sublinear term frequency 1+ln(tf), inverse document frequency ln((1+N)/(1+df))+1, L2 normalization

candidate_methods.char_tfidf_nearest: maximum cosine similarity in the frozen character TF-IDF space
candidate_methods.hybrid_char_length: maximum char TF-IDF cosine minus 0.15 times absolute token-count difference divided by max(target tokens, donor tokens, 1)
candidate_methods.hash_random: state-bank index selected by unsigned integer from first sixteen hex characters of SHA-256('rwkv-ms-state-retrieval-v1:' + target row SHA-256) modulo 1443

two_phase_stopping_rule.phase_one: Generate all four candidate methods for fit targets only. Holdout targets are forbidden.
two_phase_stopping_rule.selection_ordering: micro-F1 descending, precision descending, recall descending, candidate name ascending
two_phase_stopping_rule.phase_two_authorization: Only if every phase-one gate passes, write a signed selection.json naming exactly one method and its implementation hashes before generating holdout targets.
two_phase_stopping_rule.phase_two: Generate only the signed selected method for the 68 holdout targets, exactly once.

baselines.correct_state: Reuse the signed v9 write-then-read memory generation from natural_memory_native_routed_benchmark_v1_r2.
baselines.zero_state: Reuse the signed zero-state generation from natural_memory_native_scene_causal_router_v1.
baselines.base: Reuse the signed frozen-base generation from natural_memory_native_routed_benchmark_v1_r2.

stopping_rule: Archive, commit, and push phase-one and any authorized phase-two outcome whether pass or fail. Never read publisher-validation predictions, publisher test, or Hard32. Never generate holdout candidates before selection.json is signed.
